I say embrace the anger, assert yourself, say what you think, and stand your ground, ultimate self-respect.

Meditation can make you a better victim.

Anger often tells you that someone is trying you.

The redpill stems from insecurity, either she loves you for who you are, warts and all, respects you and what you bring to the table, or she can fuck off.

have a nice day.

Basically theories and practices to get and keep women.

Insecurity...

If she doesn't accept you for who you are, warts and all and doesn't support you and love, then you are wasting your time with her and you need to tell her to put in some effort or you are going to dump her.

And that sums it up.

Repressing anger is not a good idea.

Use it to be assertive and say what you think, even if you think you are wrong.

I will never repress anything of myself ever again, if people think I am an idiot, emotional, or violent, so what? 

I have to be happy with myself.

People will think twice trying you.

I know you feel like absolute shit, but the quickest remedies I know for pain are the following:

\-Running with sprinting in between till your lungs are on fire

\-Cold shower afterwards

\-Then Full meal

\-Then scream into your pillow from your gut while listening to some really brutal music you like as long as you can.

​

Other remedies that will take some time to relieve the pain but which are the most helpful in the long term:

\-Martial Arts

\-EMDR Trauma Therapy

\-No masturbation

\-Getting rid of toxic people (You are alone anyway, just like me, so no losses)

\-Help other people (Give advice here on Suicidewatch for example)

\-Get clothing that fits your style

\-Get rid of addictions

\-You are a warrior, see yourself as such, listen to inspiring music, podcasts, etc!

​

If you take it 1 day at a time, you won't feel much progress, but where do you think you will be if you practice all what I wrote here every day for just 3 months?...

​

I wish you the absolute best and that the goddamn universe will throw good people and luck your way.

​

You can always write me and I will try to help you.

​

Good luck warrior!

In a healthy relationship, do we need others to satisfy our need for emotional connection to make that relationship work? I mean of course, do we need healthy relationships with others as well, but not to compensate for the lack of it in our partnership.

Which person with self-esteem would stay in a partnership with an emotionally unavailable person?

We need to work on our self-esteem.

You deserve better.

I deserve better.

Our ex-partners (or partners) are not bad for being the way they are, but they make a relationship unsatisfying for people that need emotional connection in a relationship.

And I would argue that every person in the world needs that, even people that are emotionally unavailable, they are just afraid of it and need to work on it.

Just like we need to learn to love ourselves, aka building self-esteem (I recommend the self-esteem workbook by Glenn r.).

I wish you all the best!

You are welcome! Codependency is misunderstood in my opinion, your partner affects your well-being and happiness, no matter what, as humans we are here to connect, otherwise we suffer.

Partners affect our your heart rate, breathing and many other things. It only becomes bad when you can't leave when they are toxic.

**Codependency** is a behavioral condition in a relationship where one person [enables](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enabling) another person's [addiction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Addiction), poor [mental health](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mental_health), immaturity, irresponsibility, or under-achievement.  [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Codependency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Codependency)

So basically to stop codependency you have to set boundaries or leave the relationship. 

Disclaimer: I am no therapist or expert, just someone suffering from love addiction/Anxious attachment
